name: Ediorung
description: Ediorung was a planet in the Interior Regions of the Hapes Cluster. The planet was known for the dynamic holosculptures it produced; however, these were strictly judged by the Commission for the Preservation of the New Order Art Group. Porcellus, the chef for Jabba the Hutt, occasionally prepared Ediorung icefish for his master.
